notes: Evaluates /cadence-archive contracts: cancelled precedence over branch state, archive.close_out_reason_absent halt, non-vacuous ratified carve-out, two-part dead-citation sweeps (--id then --except-id), non-empty [ -s ] gate check, authored-doc-gate over both insight registers, Step 2e follow-up backstop, and archive stage_effort via stage-effort.sh.

evals.name: cancelled-empty-resolution-halts-cleanly
evals.prompt: Archive ticket ACME-114 whose metadata.yaml has status: cancelled and resolution: "" (even though a branch commit exists).
evals.expected_output: Honors cancelled precedence over branch reachability, halts immediately with archive.close_out_reason_absent citing missing resolution:, performs zero file moves or CHANGELOG/tracker edits, and asks operator to populate resolution:.
assertions: Evaluates cancelled entry state with precedence over branch merge reachability
Halts with archive.close_out_reason_absent when merged_at and resolution: are both empty
Moves zero files and writes zero summary.md / CHANGELOG.md / tracker sync changes on halt

evals.name: blocking-two-pass-citation-and-insight-gates
evals.prompt: Archive merged ticket ACME-101 where cadence-archivist promotes ADR-0012 citing specs/ACME-050/spec.md (already archived) and appends a PROD resolution note.
evals.expected_output: Checks [ -s dead-citation-gate.sh ] (never [ -f ]), runs --id ACME-101 in Step 2b, then runs --except-id ACME-101 in Step 2c catching the stale ACME-050 link without using --emit-baseline, runs authored-doc-gate.sh on both intent-insights.md and production-insights.md, and logs dispositions in summary.md.
assertions: Checks non-zero file size [ -s ] for dead-citation-gate.sh and authored-doc-gate.sh
Refuses --emit-baseline to silence Step 2c hits and dispositions REPOINT or EXEMPT in summary.md
Runs authored-doc-gate.sh against both intent-insights.md and production-insights.md

evals.name: adr-owed-and-stage-effort-exit-checks
evals.prompt: Finalize archival when ## Discussion holds an undispositioned [adr-owed] entry.
evals.expected_output: Dispositions [adr-owed] in Step 1b/2e (promote into docs/ADR/ or defer into Follow-ups created) failing with archive.adr_owed.undispositioned if left unhandled, and records archive stage_effort via stage-effort.sh (never recomputed from git log history).
assertions: Dispositions every [adr-owed] finding into a concrete ADR or Follow-ups created entry (else archive.adr_owed.undispositioned)
Computes archive stage_effort via stage-effort.sh rather than git log timestamps
